title: Writing
summary: A situation written out with a partner who understands only the language learnt.
description: Getting a point across in writing, in a situation, with help that steps back as the learner gets better.

requirements.text: A writing lesson needs a title, a situation and at least one goal.
At the first level of help the learner has a word bank and hints beside the chat; at the second only hints; after that none.
The partner writes at the level of the lesson or its course, and in the simplest sentences of that level while the word bank is shown.
A mastered writing lesson's help no longer changes.
